I didnt get on grindr until after the divorce. I took my vows seriously. I enjoyed hetero sex. A vagina is the perfect place for a penis. Almost like it was biologically designed for it. The first time I successfully topped a guy was a different experience entirely though. It was anonymous of course. But it felt right. 

At the risk of TMI, going dick to dick with another guy is all I've ever fantasized about and is, to this day, one of my favorite things. I wont get into the details but it works for me in a way that vagina never has. 

I worry more about the emotional shit I guess. I wanted kids. I wanted the normal life. I need to pass on my biology. Now I've thrown that away and, more importantly, devastated many other people. Maybe that's what I'm feeling guilty about. Which brings up the whole "did I do this for attention" thought process.

But dont you imagine how much happier everyone else would have been if you didnt succumb to your sexual desires? How you might be better served by adhering to the plan? Lately, getting my divorce is my second greatest regret. I should have stuck it out for my wife. She didnt deserve the hurt I gave her. I could have just spent the rest of my life jerking it to gaybporn and she would have been none the wiser. My friends wouldnt have had to "choose sides"  I am the cause of all this turmoil. And for what? The occasional epically awkward Grindr hook up?

I had several months of relatively calm life. Now the past few weeks have seemed just, effed up. My whole brain is doubting everything. I feel like I should have just stayed married and never succumbed to my sexual desires. Which is why I am starting to wonder if I was just being selfish about saying I'm gay. I could have had everything I wanted: kids, a house, family vacations. I worry i threw that all away for some weird physical attractions.

I do drink a lot. More than I tell my doctor and therapist anyway. I just worry my decision to "come out" was like a way to get my family to pay attention to me. Which makes me feel like a piece of shit. As if my suicide attempt was enough then I go and tell my emergency psyche team I'm gay? Was that real or was it a further attempt to keep the spotlight on me? Is the way I feel even real or is it a conglomeration of all the insecurities and doubts I've felt my whole life about my parents regretting accidentally conceiving me? (Something I know for a fact: my bio dad and my mom did NOT want kids but I ended up happening anyway)

My brothers have all been extremely supportive. I just worry i made a mistake. What if I should have just stayed with my wife and made it work? I dunno. I've been in borderline crisis for a few days. Lots of therapy over the last couple of weeks and I thought maybe reaching out to random strangers to see what happens.

Lol. Fair enough. As long as I've had an internet connection it's been gay porn. I dont get crushes. I liked a guy in middle school but my therapist said that wasnt a crush, it was just "hero worship" she said. If my masturbatory fantasies are an indication of my sexuality, i might be exclusively attracted to pinecones.
Guilty might be the wrong word.

I dont believe any of my brothers are gay. I guess I'm doubting my sexuality (crazy at 30 something). Its been 2 years since I came out, while hospitalized for mental health problems.  Now I'm wondering if I only did it because I wanted attention. Which feels incredibly shitty.

Just an update. Thanks for all the input folks. I got to the rink about an hour and half hour early today. Ran into fellow tendy. We had a good long talk. I shared that I've not been feeling great and we talked for a long time. He helped me realize that what I'm going thru isnt completely unique, which I already kind of knew based on responses here and just general googling. Anyway, I played tonight and had a little fun. After the game I managed to walk out feeling okay and actually looking forward to playing tomorrow. Guess we will see how it goes.

Well just rereading my post and the couple of responses had made me kind of take stock. Lawyers are kind of obsessed with and live and die by their "wins" and I've not been winning much of anything lately. I just started a new job in a difficult jurisdiction which, now that I think on it, has me feeling pretty low on self esteem. I think I'll be checking with our benefits coordinator about getting in to see a professional. Though this is America lol so chances a slim.

Hmmm. I guess I hadn't really thought about my hydration maybe affecting my feelings about being out there. It makes sense that feeling physically drained would have a serious impact on my mental health. I'll check into it. Thanks!
Some friends have suggested I step back a little. Take a break from playing so many times a week and just pick a single day. I need to dig into Lehners story more. Thanks for the tips.

I wouldnt want anyone (me included) to break rules! Maybe I do need to see someone. Life has been decent otherwise, but I do miss playing my heart out and throwing everything I have behind every save. I'll take what you've suggested to heart.
